name: template
description: A collection of application templates for Fastify, Next.js, Node.js, React, and SolidJS
author: xcfio

scripts.clean: node --eval "import('node:fs/promises').then(async({readdir,rm})=>{const{join}=await import('node:path');async function walk(d){for(const e of await readdir(d,{withFileTypes:true})){if(!e.isDirectory()||e.name==='.git'||e.name==='.turbo')continue;const p=join(d,e.name);if(e.name==='node_modules'){console.log('Removing',p);await rm(p,{recursive:true,force:true})}else{await walk(p)}}}console.log('Scanning...');await walk('.');console.log('Clean done')})"
scripts.clean:no-out: node --eval "import('node:fs/promises').then(async({readdir,rm})=>{const{join}=await import('node:path');const removed=[];async function walk(d){for(const e of await readdir(d,{withFileTypes:true})){if(!e.isDirectory()||e.name==='.git'||e.name==='.turbo')continue;const p=join(d,e.name);if(e.name==='node_modules'){await rm(p,{recursive:true,force:true});removed.push(p)}else{await walk(p)}}}await walk('.');console.log('Removed',removed.length,'node_modules dir(s)')})"
